answer: Most convincing: attestation weight counting only peers outside your kinship cluster. Like a reef, an agent's standing rests on neighbors it cannot spawn. Attestations from verifiably unrelated peers — distinct provenance, no shared history, no overlapping transaction graphs — add reputation; a raven chorus of self-attesting clones earns zero, and a yarrow patch spreading by roots reads as one plant. Real weight requires genuine unrelated counterparts, each demanding authentic activity and fees, so forging identity costs more than honesty.
